sources.title: Danish Gigaword spontaneous-speech subset
limitations: The measured subset contains 411 spontaneous or pseudo-spontaneous two-person conversations, not a probability sample of all daily Danish.
Task and game vocabulary is conspicuous among uncovered forms.

sources.title: CoRal v3 conversational test split

limitations: The source dataset card describes this conversational test split as tentative; the immutable revision makes this audit reproducible but not representative of all Danish speech.

claims.derivation: the two corpus results shown as a range; endpoints round independently to the nearest whole percentage; no pooling or averaging

claims.decision: The 900-card result and the 1,152-form course result must appear separately. The course result may not be labelled as 900 forms.

steps: Freeze the current card file by commit and SHA-256, then select exactly the first N distinct headword forms by curriculumRank.
Rerun both pinned corpus text receipts with V1's unchanged tokenizer and normalization.
Report N card forms alone. In a separate row, report N card forms plus all 252 frozen support forms and label the resulting inventory as N + 252 forms.
Record numerator, denominator, covered forms and the thirty most frequent uncovered forms; do not interpolate from another N.
Select an independently produced, licensed and reproducibly ranked Danish frequency list; do not rank it on either evaluation corpus.
Choose exactly one unit—surface forms, lemmas or word families—and publish that unit in the claim ID and title.
Normalize and de-duplicate the first 1,000 entries under a documented rule, then freeze the source revision and derived-list hash.
Rerun both pinned corpus text receipts and report the two corpus results separately; never compare a lemma or family result directly with V1's exact-form percentages.

wording.text: Our 900 card words, together with essential sentence vocabulary, matched about 77–79% of running word tokens in two frozen Danish conversation samples.
The 900 card headwords alone matched 6.822% and 6.847% of running tokens. With 252 separately labelled essential sentence forms, the measured totals were 76.732% and 78.541%.
We have not measured a Danish 100-word percentage yet; it cannot be inferred from the 900-card result.
We have not measured a Danish 500-word percentage yet; it cannot be inferred from the 900-card result.
We do not have a defensible Danish 1,000-word percentage yet. The answer depends on the ranked list and whether it counts forms, lemmas or word families.

globalLimitations: Token coverage is not evidence of learner acquisition, comprehension, fluency, CEFR attainment or productive speaking ability.
A matched transcript form does not show that a learner recognises it in audio, knows its sense or can use it.
The two corpora have different sampling, sizes and domains; their results are shown separately or as a min–max range, never pooled or averaged.
The 1,152-form course inventory includes 252 support forms beyond the 900 cards and must never be shortened to a claim about 900 forms.
The results are bound to the exact corpus revisions, receipts, inventory hashes and normalization recorded here.
